div.Bc: Divisor digit at the next byte's column, added to build the next multiple.
div.Bc1: Divisor digit one column lower, used to recover the carry.
div.Mp0: Previous multiple's digit at the next byte's column.
div.Mp1: Previous multiple's digit one column lower, used to recover the carry.
div.MqJ: Digit of the chosen multiple M_q subtracted at the next byte's column.
div.MqJ1: Digit of the chosen multiple one column lower, used to recover the borrow.
div.N2: Square of len A, the number of dividend digits.
div.NS2: Square of len A + s, used to compute len A times s.
div.Q2: Square of this row's quotient digit.
div.QS2: Square of this row's quotient digit + s, used to compute q times s.
div.R2: Square of the next byte's row.
div.RS2: Square of the next byte's row + s, used to compute row times s.
div.RS2S: Square of this byte's own row.
div.RSS2: Square of this byte's own row + s, used to compute own row times s.
div.Rj: Digit of the shifted remainder R' = 10*R + a_i at the next byte's column.
div.Rj1: Digit of the shifted remainder R' one column lower, used to recover the borrow.
div.Rp: Previous remainder's digit one column lower: the shifted remainder 10*R digit.
div.Rp1: Previous remainder's digit two columns lower, used for the borrow.
div.S2: Square of the grid stride s (s = len B + 2), used to multiply by s.
div.SX2: Square of x + s, used to compute s times x.
div.SXS2: Square of this byte's own cell index plus s, used to compute s times it.
div.Scol0: 1 if this byte is in column 0 of its row (a quotient digit).
div.Scolge1: 1 if this byte is in column 1 or later, not the row's first cell.
div.Srow9: 1 if this byte is in row 9, the zero starting row.
div.Srowge10: 1 if this byte is in row 10 or later.
div.Srowge9: 1 if this byte is in row 9 or later (the remainder rows).
div.T2: Square of the answer digit index (counted after an optional '-').
div.TS2: Square of the answer digit index + s, used to compute index times s.
div.X2: Square of x, the next byte's cell index after '='.
div.XS2: Square of this byte's own cell index (x - 1).
div.Zq: Position of the first nonzero quotient digit (row 9's zero digit if there is none).
div.col0: 1 if the next byte goes in column 0 of its row (the quotient digit in rows 10 and later).
div.col1: 1 if the next byte goes in column 1, the remainder's units digit, where the dividend digit a_i comes in.
div.col2: 1 if the next byte goes in column 2, the remainder digit just above the units digit.
div.colsep: 1 if the next byte goes in the last column of its row (the ',' after a multiple).
div.endrow: 1 if the next byte is in row 10 + len A, just past the last row, where ';' goes.
div.row9: 1 if the next byte is in row 9, the zero quotient digit and zero starting remainder.
div.rowge10: 1 if the next byte is in a quotient-and-remainder row (row 10 or later).
div.rowle8: 1 if the next byte is in rows 0-8, where the multiples of B are written.
div.rskey: Position tag on the first cell of each remainder row, the fallback when all upper digits are equal.
div.src: Grid position of the answer digit to copy next.
div.tBc: Where to read divisor digit B[col], counted from b's left edge (clamps onto that edge, which reads 0).
div.tBc1: Where to read divisor digit B[col-1], for the carry (clamps onto b's left edge, which reads 0).
div.tM0: Where to read the previous multiple's digit at the next byte's column (0 means '=', read as M_0 = 0).
div.tM1: Where to read the previous multiple's digit one column lower, for the carry (0 means '=').
div.tMq: Where to read the chosen multiple's digit M_q[j] (0 means '=', read as 0 when q = 0).
div.tMq1: Where to read the chosen multiple's digit M_q[j-1], for the borrow (0 means '=').
div.zq: Tag marking the earliest nonzero quotient digit in this frame, with a weaker fallback on row 9's zero digit.

mul.J2: j squared, used to compute j times s.
mul.JS2: (j+s) squared, used to compute j times s.
mul.K2: k squared, used to compute k times s.
mul.KS2: (k+s) squared, used to compute k times s.
mul.SX2: (s+x) squared, used to compute s times x.
mul.T0: Digit m of the previous line, for the previous column's sum.
mul.T1: Digit m+1 of the previous line (0 on the first line).
mul.X2: x squared, used to compute s times x.
mul.Z: Position of the product's top nonzero digit.
mul.Zo: How many digits the answer has, minus 1.
mul.csrc: Where the next product digit to gather sits.
mul.tAm: Where digit m of a is.
mul.tAm1: Where digit m-1 of a is.
mul.tPrev0: Where the previous line's digit m is.
mul.tPrev1: Where the previous line's digit m+1 is.
mul.zkey: Tag on nonzero digits of the gathered product.

pow.LnzB: Position of the latest nonzero digit at or before the exponent's last digit.
pow.Ycp_is_caret: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '^'.
pow.Ycp_is_dot: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '.'.
pow.Ycp_is_lpar: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '('.
pow.Ycp_is_minus: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '-'.
pow.Ycp_is_plus: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '+'.
pow.Ycp_is_rpar: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is ')'.
pow.Ycp_is_slash: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '/'.
pow.Ycp_is_star: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '*'.
pow.Ycp_oh0: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '0'.
pow.Ycp_oh1: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '1'.
pow.Ycp_oh2: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '2'.
pow.Ycp_oh3: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '3'.
pow.Ycp_oh4: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '4'.
pow.Ycp_oh5: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '5'.
pow.Ycp_oh6: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '6'.
pow.Ycp_oh7: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '7'.
pow.Ycp_oh8: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '8'.
pow.Ycp_oh9: Copied byte: 1 if the byte at the copy source (src) is '9'.
pow.d0: Value of the exponent's first digit.
pow.d0one: 1 if the exponent's first digit is 1.
pow.dj: Exponent digit d_j that the halved digit being written comes from (even case).
pow.dj1: Exponent digit d_{j-1}, just before d_j; if odd it adds 5 to the halved digit.
pow.end_even: 1 when the even case is active and its expansion is complete, so the next byte is ']'.
pow.end_negexp: 1 when the negexp case is active and its expansion is complete, so the next byte is ']'.
pow.end_odd: 1 when the odd case is active and its expansion is complete, so the next byte is ']'.
pow.end_unit: 1 when the unit case is active and its expansion is complete, so the next byte is ']'.
pow.end_zero: 1 when the zero case is active and its expansion is complete, so the next byte is ']'.
pow.endraw_even: 1 when u equals the length of the even expansion (ignores which case is active).
pow.endraw_negexp: 1 when u equals the length of the negexp expansion (ignores which case is active).
pow.endraw_odd: 1 when u equals the length of the odd expansion (ignores which case is active).
pow.endraw_unit: 1 when u equals the length of the unit expansion (ignores which case is active).
pow.endraw_zero: 1 when u equals the length of the zero expansion (ignores which case is active).
pow.fl2: floor(ld/2): half the exponent's last digit, rounded down (gives its parity).
pow.flj: floor(d_j/2), the halved digit's own contribution.
pow.flj1: floor(d_{j-1}/2), used to get the parity of d_{j-1}.
pow.lb1: 1 if the exponent has exactly one digit.
pow.lbge2: 1 if the exponent has at least two digits.
pow.lt_even_0: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 0 ('(') in the even layout.
pow.lt_even_1: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 1 (the base a) in the even layout.
pow.lt_even_2: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 2 ('*') in the even layout.
pow.lt_even_3: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 3 (the base a) in the even layout.
pow.lt_even_4: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 4 (')') in the even layout.
pow.lt_even_5: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 5 ('^') in the even layout.
pow.lt_even_6: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 6 (the digits of b/2) in the even layout.
pow.lt_even_7: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of the end of the expansion in the even layout.
pow.lt_negexp_0: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 0 ('(') in the negexp layout.
pow.lt_negexp_1: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 1 ('1') in the negexp layout.
pow.lt_negexp_2: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 2 ('/') in the negexp layout.
pow.lt_negexp_3: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 3 (the base a) in the negexp layout.
pow.lt_negexp_4: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 4 ('^') in the negexp layout.
pow.lt_negexp_5: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 5 (the exponent's digits without the '-') in the negexp layout.
pow.lt_negexp_6: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 6 (')') in the negexp layout.
pow.lt_negexp_7: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of the end of the expansion in the negexp layout.
pow.lt_odd_0: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 0 ('(') in the odd layout.
pow.lt_odd_1: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 1 (the base a) in the odd layout.
pow.lt_odd_2: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 2 ('*') in the odd layout.
pow.lt_odd_3: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 3 (the base a) in the odd layout.
pow.lt_odd_4: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 4 ('^') in the odd layout.
pow.lt_odd_5: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 5 (the exponent's digits except the last) in the odd layout.
pow.lt_odd_6: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 6 (the last digit minus 1) in the odd layout.
pow.lt_odd_7: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 7 (')') in the odd layout.
pow.lt_odd_8: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of the end of the expansion in the odd layout.
pow.lt_unit_0: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 0 (the base a) in the unit layout.
pow.lt_unit_1: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of the end of the expansion in the unit layout.
pow.lt_zero_0: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of segment 0 ('1') in the zero layout.
pow.lt_zero_1: 1 while the next expansion byte index u is before the start of the end of the expansion in the zero layout.
pow.nzb: 1 if the exponent is nonzero (it has a nonzero digit), else 0.
pow.sbp: 1 if the exponent is negative (a '-' right after the frame's '^'), else 0.
pow.seg_even_0: 1 when the even case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 0: '('.
pow.seg_even_1: 1 when the even case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 1: the base a.
pow.seg_even_2: 1 when the even case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 2: '*'.
pow.seg_even_3: 1 when the even case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 3: the base a.
pow.seg_even_4: 1 when the even case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 4: ')'.
pow.seg_even_5: 1 when the even case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 5: '^'.
pow.seg_even_6: 1 when the even case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 6: the digits of b/2.
pow.seg_negexp_0: 1 when the negexp case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 0: '('.
pow.seg_negexp_1: 1 when the negexp case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 1: '1'.
pow.seg_negexp_2: 1 when the negexp case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 2: '/'.
pow.seg_negexp_3: 1 when the negexp case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 3: the base a.
pow.seg_negexp_4: 1 when the negexp case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 4: '^'.
pow.seg_negexp_5: 1 when the negexp case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 5: the exponent's digits without the '-'.
pow.seg_negexp_6: 1 when the negexp case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 6: ')'.
pow.seg_odd_0: 1 when the odd case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 0: '('.
pow.seg_odd_1: 1 when the odd case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 1: the base a.
pow.seg_odd_2: 1 when the odd case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 2: '*'.
pow.seg_odd_3: 1 when the odd case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 3: the base a.
pow.seg_odd_4: 1 when the odd case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 4: '^'.
pow.seg_odd_5: 1 when the odd case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 5: the exponent's digits except the last.
pow.seg_odd_6: 1 when the odd case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 6: the last digit minus 1.
pow.seg_odd_7: 1 when the odd case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 7: ')'.
pow.seg_unit_0: 1 when the unit case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 0: the base a.
pow.seg_zero_0: 1 when the zero case is active and the next expansion byte is in segment 0: '1'.
pow.semi: 1 when the next byte is body byte 0, the END byte ';'.

sub.Zo: How far the top nonzero working digit sits past the first one.
sub.exA: 1 once a has no digit i.
sub.exB: 1 once b has no digit i.
sub.n9key: Tag on working digits that aren't 9.
sub.tA: Where digit i of a is.
sub.tA1: Where digit i-1 of a is.
sub.tB: Where digit i of b is.
sub.tB1: Where digit i-1 of b is.
sub.zlow: Tag that makes this frame's earliest nonzero working digit win.
